scripts.build:fast: npm run build && cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:portable: npm run bundle-python && npm run bundle-ffmpeg && npm run build:fast && npm run bundle-portable
scripts.build:installers: npm run bundle-python && npm run bundle-ffmpeg && npm run tauri build -- --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.build:release: npm run build:installers && npm run bundle-portable
